title: ID0420424-DC/Si-D/CZ-[ MP / R7 170002202 ]  Unable to charge CP1
description:
Reported issue:  we are facing a problem with this charger. There 3 Si-D chargers on this location. But this one has a problem that logging many data from the EcoG component. It says: Error: No reply in 4.25s. Yesterday the customer was not able to charge at CP1, in the log I can see many attempts where Pilot State went from A→B2, then B2→A... A→E... E→B2... B2→E. Please would you be so kind to help us and analyze the log what is the issue? The customers report that it is not possible to charge on the CP1. The customer has successful charging session with CP2.
Solution:

additional_info.body:
Dear Čepička, Tomáš (RC-CZ DI CS SD SO LVD),
1. Timestamp: 2025-04-15T19:16:11 to 2025-04-15T19:44:45
2025-04-15, 19:16:11        2025-04-15T19:16:11.972827+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:err] ecog-secc-adapter/6ba6ff534efa[734]:
Error polling coap://10.20.17.100:5683/state Error: No reply in 4.25s
This COAP polling error indicates a temporary disconnection between the charger and its controller (SECC), rendering the outlet unavailable and transitioning its state to "Out of Order". The Sicharge D charger successfully re-established connection with the SECC within approximately 5 seconds.
As a result of this brief disconnection, you may observe irregular transitions in pilot states during the attempted session, such as:
A → B2 → A → E → B2 → E
This is a known issue and is scheduled to be addressed in an upcoming firmware release.
2. Timestamp: 2025-04-22T09:12:53 to 2025-04-22T10:24:56
For this interval, we have reviewed the logs and identified that the COAP polling error persisted for over an hour. Given the extended duration of the issue, we will create a child case and escalate it for further technical support and resolution.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar

additional_info.subject: RE: 0420424 - ID0420424-DC/Si-D/CZ-[ MP / R7 170002202 ]  Unable to charge CP1 CRM:00472000332
additional_info.body:
Hello Tomas,
The FW version is only for Ecog and it's 1.4.12, originally was 1.4.5. We have update it already.
This new version brings more features but regarding to this case has hardening patches regarding CoAP communication.
It's expected to observe less messages about communication problems. If you have other chargers with the same problem you can open a ticket requesting the update or wait for the new Sicharge D FW v8 that will include this version.
For now I will close this ticket since there is no actions pending from our side. Let me know if you agree.
With best regards,
